original_value: The ultimate in performance, upgraded. Faster than the 970 EVO, the 970 EVO Plus is powered by the latest V-NAND technology and firmware optimization. It maximizes the potential of NVMe bandwidth for unbeatable computing. It comes in capacities of up to 1TB, with the reliability of up to 600 TBW.Pri

result.paraphrase: The 970 EVO Plus raises performance to the next level, delivering faster speeds than the 970 EVO. Powered by the latest V-NAND and firmware optimizations, it makes full use of NVMe bandwidth for outstanding computing performance. Available in capacities up to 1TB, it also offers reliability rated up to 600 TBW.Pri
